reported.name: outlet_mass_sum

reported.name: reactor_duty
reported.anchor: FOSSEE DWSIM manual Exp 5: self-learning question 1, heat duty of the reaction: isothermal at 298.15 K, duty = extent x heat of reaction; independent: dHf(NH3, g) = -45.9 kJ/mol (standard value, three digits), so -91800 kJ/kmol N2 x 5.00 kmol/h

tolerance.note: mole balance is exact, so 0.1 percent; the duty tolerance (2 percent) is wider because the heat of formation is a three-digit standard value

scenarios.why: the same reactor at 50 % conversion: the mole balance gives 75.00 kmol/h out and a duty proportional to the extent (independent calculation)
the same reactor at 10 % conversion: the mole balance gives 95.00 kmol/h out and a duty proportional to the extent (independent calculation)

review.method: exact mole balance with CoolProp molar masses; duty from the standard heat of formation of ammonia
